mapper.select: SELECT ea.id, ea.question_id AS questionId, q.content, q.question_type AS questionType, q.option_a AS optionA, q.option_b AS optionB, q.option_c AS optionC, q.option_d AS optionD, q.answer AS correctAnswer, ea.answer AS studentAnswer, ea.score, ea.is_correct AS isCorrect FROM exam_answer ea LEFT JOIN question q ON ea.question_id = q.id WHERE ea.record_id = #{recordId} ORDER BY q.id
